children: Alpha Pro Tech’s third-quarter sales and earnings increased year over year, as growth in Disposable Protective Apparel and higher Building Supply housewrap sales lifted revenue. Higher gross margin reflected lower tariff rates and pricing actions amid rising energy, freight and raw-material costs; increased affiliate income also contributed to earnings growth.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share”.
: Segment sales rose 1.7% to $9.431M; housewrap sales increased 13.1%, partly offset by lower synthetic roof underlayment and other woven material sales.
: Segment sales climbed 30.2% to $7.173M, with garment sales up 30.6%; management cited broad distributor growth and higher selling prices.
: Gross margin increased to 41.8% from 39.7%, reflecting lower tariff rates and pricing actions; higher energy, freight and petroleum-based input costs remain pressures.
: Management described the rest of 2026 building market as soft but generally stable and plans to expand housewrap and synthetic roof underlayment offerings in 2027.
